verdict.rationale: Elicit is a research SaaS platform, not purely a coding agent, so an MCP-server story applies. Its first-party help article documents an official hosted MCP endpoint (https://elicit.com/api/mcp) with a Claude Code setup command, and says all API functionality is available to Claude Desktop, Claude Code and other MCP-compatible clients. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works, documented tool list and authentication details for the MCP endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: claude mcp add --transport http elicit https://elicit.com/api/mcp
All API functionality is also available via MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, enabling use from Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and other MCP-compatible clients.
